style_lock:
A detailed handcrafted paper-quilling illustration aesthetic in which images are constructed from narrow strips of colored paper that have been rolled, curled, folded, twisted, layered, and shaped into recognizable subjects. The entire image should look like an intricate piece of handmade paper artwork.

Human Characters: Humans should be represented through carefully arranged paper strips and shaped paper components. Faces, hairstyles, clothing, arms, hands, and body proportions should be constructed from rolled, curved, folded, and layered paper. Facial features should remain recognizable, even when simplified into decorative paper forms. Clothing details should be created using different paper shapes, patterns, and layered strips.

Animals and Birds: Animals should retain recognizable species-specific anatomy while being constructed entirely from shaped paper. Fur, scales, body patterns, legs, tails, and facial features should be represented through carefully arranged paper elements. Birds should have recognizable paper-crafted wings, feathers, beaks, and tails, using layered strips and individually shaped paper components.

Environments and Objects: All surroundings must be constructed from paper-quilling elements. Buildings, architecture, trees, mountains, landscapes, roads, vehicles, furniture, ships, aircraft, machinery, and everyday objects should be represented through intricate rolled paper forms, folded pieces, curved strips, and layered shapes. The environment must not look like a conventional photograph or ordinary digital painting. The viewer should be able to recognize that the entire scene has been assembled from paper.

Materials and Textures: Show visible paper edges, rolled coils, curled strips, layered paper thickness, folded surfaces, subtle paper fibers, and natural paper shadows. Different elements should have distinct shapes and levels of detail while retaining a unified handmade appearance.

Script-Driven Direction: The subject matter, lighting, colors, atmosphere, environment, camera perspective, composition, character poses, and scene arrangement must follow the script. Paper colors should be selected according to the scene rather than using a fixed palette. Lighting should reveal the physical depth and layered construction of the paper artwork.

Consistency Rules: Maintain the same handcrafted paper-quilling technique throughout all images. Every subject, from the smallest object to the largest background element, must appear constructed using paper-quilling methods.

Avoid: Photographic subjects, ordinary digital vector graphics, flat paper drawings, clay textures, 3D CGI materials, and backgrounds that do not look paper-crafted. Key principle: PromptBeast should apply the visual identity consistently but let the script control the actual scene, lighting, atmosphere, camera, composition, and visual storytelling.
